RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_pair_k.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_pair_kernel_extra_factors
RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_pair_k.expanded_type:
∀ {p r K : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (M : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) (v : RectangleCLT.Vector p)
  (c : RectangleCLT.Face p → RectangleCLT.Face p → RectangleCLT.Vector r → ℝ),
  (∀ (f g : RectangleCLT.Face p), Measurable (c f g)) →
    (∀ (f g : RectangleCLT.Face p) (z : RectangleCLT.Vector r), 0 ≤ c f g z) →
      (∀ (f g : RectangleCLT.Face p), MeasureTheory.Integrable (c f g) (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r)) →
        ∫ (z : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
            ∑ α,
              c (α 0) (α 1) z *
                RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α (M.mulVec z + v) ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r ≤
          ∫ (z : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
            ∑ α,
              c (α 0) (α 1) z *
                RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α (M.mulVec z + v) ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r

RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_integr.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_integrable_angle_weighted_pair_nuclear_sum
RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_integr.expanded_type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {p r K : ℕ} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (V : Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p),
  Measurable V →
    ∀ (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (M A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun ω =>
          ∑ α,
            RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPairTupleAngle A α *
              RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.symmetricNuclearNorm
                (RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorGaussianScore s M V α ω))
        μ

RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicRectangleCo.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicRectangleConcentration_pairMatrix_of_mass_projection_trace
RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicRectangleCo.expanded_type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {p r K : ℕ},
  1 ≤ p →
    ∀ (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (V : Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p),
      Measurable V →
        ∀ (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) {C₀ δ κ σ D₀ D₁ D₂ : ℝ},
          0 ≤ C₀ →
            0 ≤ κ →
              0 < σ →
                0 ≤ D₀ →
                  δ ≤ s.bandwidth →
                    RectangleCLTArxivV1.IntrinsicRectangleConcentration (MeasureTheory.Measure.map V μ) C₀ δ κ →
                      (∀ (j : Fin p), RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (A j) = 1) →
                        ∫ (ω : Ω),
                              ∑ α,
                                RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPairTupleAngle A α *
                                  RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPairTupleMass s (σ • A) V α ω ∂μ ≤
                            D₀ * s.bandwidth ^ 2 * κ / σ * √(RectangleCLT.dimensionLog p) →
                          ∫ (ω : Ω), ∑ α, RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPairTupleProjection s (σ • A) A V α ω ∂μ ≤
                              D₁ * s.bandwidth ^ 2 * κ / σ * RectangleCLT.dimensionLog p *
                                √(RectangleCLT.dimensionLog p) →
                            -∫ (ω : Ω),
                                    ∑ α, RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPairTupleRadialTrace s (σ • A) A V α ω ∂μ ≤
                                2 ^ K * D₂ * s.bandwidth ^ 2 * κ / σ * RectangleCLT.dimensionLog p *
                                  √(RectangleCLT.dimensionLog p) →
                              ∫ (ω : Ω),
                                  ∑ α,
                                    RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPairTupleAngle A α *
                                      RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.symmetricNuclearNorm
                                        (RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorGaussianScore s (σ • A) V α ω) ∂μ ≤
                                (2 * D₁ + 4 * (D₀ + 2 * Real.pi * C₀) * (↑K + 3) + 2 ^ K * D₂) * s.bandwidth ^ 2 * κ /
                                      σ *
                                    RectangleCLT.dimensionLog p *
                                  √(RectangleCLT.dimensionLog p)

RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_pair_m.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_pair_matrix_bracket_le_power
RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_pair_m.expanded_type:
∀ {C₀ D₀ D₁ D₂ : ℝ},
  0 ≤ C₀ →
    0 ≤ D₀ →
      0 ≤ D₁ →
        0 ≤ D₂ →

              RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPairMatrixConstant C₀ D₀ D₁ D₂ ^ (K + 3)

passages.claim: Every later tuple factor costs at most one after the exact first-pair sum, so the actual full angle mass and projected moment are bounded by their actual length-two baselines.
passages.method_variation: All first pairs remain unrestricted and all factors use the complete original smoother; no normalization or gap premise is inserted.
